race.comment: DON'T BACK DOWN (7) earns top billing after going within a head of Pure Melody over 2000m at this track, doing it at big odds and still having a late check noted by stewards. The return to 1600m is the main qualification, but she has placed at the trip and her recent figure is the strongest winning pointer. SOLAR ORBIT (6) is the immediate danger after being beaten just over half a length at this venue, a sharp turnaround from his Cootamundra run and assisted by a 1.5kg claim. THE HARD ROAD (3) brings winning form, having beaten Aquilino in a Mdn at Queanbeyan as favourite despite being tightened at the 300m; the extra ground is the question. DUNNA RUNNA (1) has BM58 form, a prior 1600m win and the leading track jockey aboard, though his latest Orange eighth leaves him with ground to make up.
